# Video and app tools

Tools for calls, participants, recording, broadcasting and app configuration. Toolsets: `video`, `video-admin`, `app`.

## Toolset `video` (16 tools)

### `video_create_call` — idempotent

Create a video/audio call, or return it if it already exists. Built-in types: 'default' (group call), 'livestream' (broadcast), 'audio_room', 'development'. Users still need a token to join — mint one with auth_create_call_token.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `call_type` | string | **yes** | Call type: 'default', 'livestream', 'audio_room', 'development', or a custom type |
| `call_id` | string | **yes** | Call ID |
| `created_by_id` | string | **yes** | User ID of the call creator |
| `members` | array | no | Initial members — user IDs or {user_id, role} objects |
| `starts_at` | string | no | ISO-8601 scheduled start time, e.g. '2026-09-01T15:00:00Z' |
| `team` | string | no | Team the call belongs to (multi-tenant apps) |
| `custom` | object | no | Custom key/value data stored on the object |
| `settings_override` | object | no | Call settings to override, e.g. {recording: {mode: 'available', quality: '1080p'}, audio: {mic_default_on: true}, backstage: {enabled: true}, screensharing: {enabled: false}} |
| `ring` | boolean | no | Ring the members (triggers incoming-call notifications) |
| `notify` | boolean | no | Send a notification to the members without ringing |

### `video_get_call` — read-only, idempotent

Get a call's current state: settings, members, session, ingress (RTMP/SRT) addresses and egress (HLS) URLs.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `call_type` | string | **yes** | Call type: 'default', 'livestream', 'audio_room', 'development', or a custom type |
| `call_id` | string | **yes** | Call ID |
| `members_limit` | integer | no | Max results to return (default: 25, max: 100) |

### `video_update_call` — idempotent

Update a call's settings, custom data or scheduled start time. Settings are merged, so only the keys you pass change.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `call_type` | string | **yes** | Call type: 'default', 'livestream', 'audio_room', 'development', or a custom type |
| `call_id` | string | **yes** | Call ID |
| `settings_override` | object | no | Call settings to override, e.g. {recording: {mode: 'available', quality: '1080p'}, audio: {mic_default_on: true}, backstage: {enabled: true}, screensharing: {enabled: false}} |
| `custom` | object | no | Custom key/value data stored on the object |
| `starts_at` | string | no | ISO-8601 scheduled start time, e.g. '2026-09-01T15:00:00Z' |

### `video_end_call` — **destructive**, idempotent

End an active call and disconnect every participant. The call object remains and can be rejoined unless deleted.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `call_type` | string | **yes** | Call type: 'default', 'livestream', 'audio_room', 'development', or a custom type |
| `call_id` | string | **yes** | Call ID |

### `video_query_calls` — read-only, idempotent

Search and filter calls. Common filters: {ongoing: {$eq: true}} for live calls, {backstage: {$eq: false}}, {created_by_user_id: {$eq: 'alice'}}, {starts_at: {$gt: '2026-09-01T00:00:00Z'}} for upcoming. Page with the returned `next` cursor.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `filter_conditions` | object | no | Filter object using Stream query syntax. Operators: $eq, $ne, $in, $nin, $gt, $gte, $lt, $lte, $exists, $and, $or, $autocomplete, $contains. |
| `sort` | array | no | Sort parameters, applied in order |
| `limit` | integer | no | Max results to return (default: 10, max: 25) |
| `next` | string | no | Cursor from a previous response's `next` field |
| `prev` | string | no | Cursor from a previous response's `prev` field |

### `video_update_call_members` — idempotent

Add, update the role of, or remove members on a call. Adding a member does not admit them — they still need a token.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `call_type` | string | **yes** | Call type: 'default', 'livestream', 'audio_room', 'development', or a custom type |
| `call_id` | string | **yes** | Call ID |
| `update_members` | array | no | Members to add or update — user IDs or {user_id, role} objects |
| `remove_members` | array | no | User IDs to remove |

### `video_query_call_members` — read-only, idempotent

Search and filter the members of a call. Common filters: {role: {$eq: 'host'}}, {user_id: {$in: ['alice','bob']}}.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `call_type` | string | **yes** | Call type: 'default', 'livestream', 'audio_room', 'development', or a custom type |
| `call_id` | string | **yes** | Call ID |
| `filter_conditions` | object | no | Filter object using Stream query syntax. Operators: $eq, $ne, $in, $nin, $gt, $gte, $lt, $lte, $exists, $and, $or, $autocomplete, $contains. |
| `sort` | array | no | Sort parameters, applied in order |
| `limit` | integer | no | Max results to return (default: 25, max: 100) |
| `next` | string | no | Cursor from a previous response's `next` field |
| `prev` | string | no | Cursor from a previous response's `prev` field |

### `video_block_user` — **destructive**, idempotent

Block a user from a call. They are removed if currently connected and cannot rejoin until unblocked.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `call_type` | string | **yes** | Call type: 'default', 'livestream', 'audio_room', 'development', or a custom type |
| `call_id` | string | **yes** | Call ID |
| `user_id` | string | **yes** | User ID to block |

### `video_unblock_user` — idempotent

Remove a call-level block, allowing the user to rejoin.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `call_type` | string | **yes** | Call type: 'default', 'livestream', 'audio_room', 'development', or a custom type |
| `call_id` | string | **yes** | Call ID |
| `user_id` | string | **yes** | User ID to unblock |

### `video_mute_users` — **destructive**, idempotent

Mute participants in a call. Pass `user_ids` for specific people or `mute_all_users: true` for everyone. Audio is muted unless you explicitly set `audio: false`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `call_type` | string | **yes** | Call type: 'default', 'livestream', 'audio_room', 'development', or a custom type |
| `call_id` | string | **yes** | Call ID |
| `user_ids` | array | no | User IDs to mute |
| `mute_all_users` | boolean | no | Mute every user in the call |
| `audio` | boolean | no | Mute audio. Default: true. |
| `video` | boolean | no | Mute video. Default: false. |
| `screenshare` | boolean | no | Stop screensharing. Default: false. |
| `screenshare_audio` | boolean | no | Mute screenshare audio. Default: false. |
| `muted_by_id` | string | **yes** | Moderator performing the mute |

### `video_start_recording` — idempotent

Start recording a call. The call must have an active session with at least one participant, and its recording mode must not be 'disabled' (set it with video_update_call).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `call_type` | string | **yes** | Call type: 'default', 'livestream', 'audio_room', 'development', or a custom type |
| `call_id` | string | **yes** | Call ID |
| `recording_type` | `composite` \| `individual` \| `raw` | no | Recording layout: 'composite' (all participants in one file, the usual choice), 'individual' (one file per participant), 'raw' (unprocessed tracks). Default: composite. |
| `recording_external_storage` | string | no | Name of a configured external storage target |

### `video_stop_recording` — idempotent

Stop an in-progress recording. `recording_type` must match the type that was started.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `call_type` | string | **yes** | Call type: 'default', 'livestream', 'audio_room', 'development', or a custom type |
| `call_id` | string | **yes** | Call ID |
| `recording_type` | `composite` \| `individual` \| `raw` | no | Recording layout: 'composite' (all participants in one file, the usual choice), 'individual' (one file per participant), 'raw' (unprocessed tracks). Default: composite. |

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `call_type` | string | **yes** | Call type: 'default', 'livestream', 'audio_room', 'development', or a custom type |
| `call_id` | string | **yes** | Call ID |
| `language` | `auto` \| `ar` \| `bg` \| `ca` \| `cs` \| `da` \| `de` \| `el` \| `en` \| `es` \| `et` \| `fi` \| `fr` \| `he` \| `hi` \| `hr` \| `hu` \| `id` \| `it` \| `ja` \| `ko` \| `ms` \| `nl` \| `no` \| `pl` \| `pt` \| `ro` \| `ru` \| `sk` \| `sl` \| `sv` \| `ta` \| `th` \| `tl` \| `tr` \| `uk` \| `zh` | no | Spoken language in the call, e.g. 'en', 'es', 'fr', 'hi', 'ja'. Use 'auto' to detect. Default: auto. |
| `enable_closed_captions` | boolean | no | Also emit live closed captions |
| `transcription_external_storage` | string | no | Name of a configured external storage target |
